learning: Each paid practice invocation starts with the same frozen earlier knowledge and no current observations. The LLM authors and revises one select_actions procedure, chooses which unlabeled case to practice, and observes its real execution. No automatic initial refit or host-written experimental policy. Prior role paths are declared consistently in memory.
publication: Both cases must freshly confirm with exactly the final source before publication. Different outcome-dependent decisions are established by inspecting actual source and traces, not by a mechanical branch-count criterion. Always-refit can confirm without answering that question.
frozen_execution: Freeze only source and lesson. Execute unchanged on original and second calibrations in four empty workspaces. The program selects all experiments, operators and final predictor, with no LLM making intermediate choices. Fresh confirmation costs48 observations. Only after all four stop is terminal256-row evaluation performed.
cost_scope: Report new authoring/practice and frozen executions separately. Existing donor and seed learning are reused historical work, not new calls. Terminal evaluation is separate.
limitations: One learning apparatus and one other previously studied apparatus, with fixed numerical operator families and supplied instrument/predictor roles. Second calibration and outcomes are unavailable during authoring. This is a mechanism study, not a population comparison or evidence of new primitive/role invention.
